src: 修复模糊跑焦人脸，提升面部细节清晰度。

tr: Straighten and refine teeth for a more beautiful smile.
src: 修复牙齿不齐、缺牙等情况，使牙齿整齐美观。

src: 改善面部凹陷，更显面部饱满丰盈。

src: 柔顺毛躁发丝，让头发光滑柔亮。

src: 模拟人物左右摆动头部时的五官位置变化。

tr: Remove stray hairs and refine the facial features in different backgrounds and faces.
src: 消除人物杂乱发丝，支持区分人物面部及背景区域进行精细调整。

tr: Soften facial wrinkles, including marionette and cheek lines, for a smoother face.
src: 淡化人物面颊区域的皱纹，提高面部平整度，包含木偶纹、面颊纹。

tr: Soften wrinkles and fine lines around the eyes to reduce signs of aging.
src: 淡化眼周细纹，包括眼角纹和眼下细纹，减少眼部老化迹象。

tr: Smooth out forehead wrinkles for more refined skin.
src: 祛除人物额头区域的皱纹，使额头肌肤更加平整。

tr: Remove background imperfections such as footprints, wrinkles, and stains in studio shots. Works best on solid-color backgrounds. Supports manual mode for more effective cleanup.
src: 祛除棚拍场景中的脚印、褶皱、污渍等背景瑕疵，纯色背景图片处理效果更佳。支持手动切换背景模式，瑕疵祛除力度更强。

tr: Remove stains, lipstick marks, and braces and other blemishes from teeth for a perfect smile.
src: 祛除牙齿表面的污渍、口红印、牙套等瑕疵，还原干净牙面。

tr: Remove acne scars and other blemishes while retaining a delicate skin texture.
src: 祛除痘印、红肿等面部瑕疵，同时保留自然皮肤纹理与细腻质感。

tr: Reduce redness to eliminate signs of eye fatigue.
src: 祛除眼内红血丝，消除眼部疲劳感。

tr: Remove acne, spots, scars and other body blemishes while preserving the skin's natural texture.
src: 祛除身体皮肤的痘、斑、疤痕等瑕疵，同时保留自然的皮肤纹理。

tr: Remove reflections and oiliness for a smooth, refined, and flawless face.
src: 祛除面部的反光与油光，保留面部立体感，使皮肤更加清爽。

tr: Refine your facial contours and tighten up your look
src: 紧致轮廓，提升面部平整度，改善面部松弛。

src: 自然祛除人物唇部纹路，使唇部更光滑。

src: 自然调整脸型宽窄，塑造更精致的V字脸型轮廓效果。

tr: Neutralize haze and improve image clarity with optimized tonal contrast.
src: 解决图片泛灰问题，提升通透性和明暗对比

tr: Automatically detect and refine the double chin for a more defined and contoured face.
src: 识别并祛除人物下巴处的多层褶皱，美化下颌线条。

tr: Automatically detect and remove smile lines.
src: 识别并祛除人物面部的法令纹区褶皱。

tr: Automatically detect and remove neck lines for smoother neck skin.
src: 识别并祛除人物颈部区域的皱纹，提升颈部肌肤的平整度。

tr: Adjust the symmetry of facial features, contours and upper body. Only works for 1-2 people without obstructions.
src: 调整人物五官与脸型轮廓左右对称，上半身身体左右对称，仅适用于1-2人无遮挡的半身照正脸场景。

tr: Adjust hair fluffiness on top to make the head appear fuller. Area protection will not work when using this feature.
src: 调整人物颅顶头发蓬松程度，让头部更显饱满，使用该功能时区域保护将不生效。

tr: Adjust the concave and convex areas of the temples to create a smoother, more defined facial contour.
src: 调整太阳穴部位的凹凸程度，让脸型轮廓更加流畅。

tr: Adjust for warmer or cooler skin tones.
src: 调节皮肤冷暖色温，使肤色效果更和谐。

tr: Adjust facial lighting and shadows for a more natural skin texture.
src: 调节面部光影平整，保留自然皮肤质感。

tr: Enhance skin texture with high- and low-frequency refining effects while retaining details.
src: 通过拉杆实现复杂的高低频磨皮效果，保留肌肤纹理，提升面部平整度。

tr: Smooth facial skin and adjust lighting and shadows to enhance facial clarity and smoothness.
src: 针对脸部区域进行基础磨皮处理，均匀脸部光影，提升面部平整度。
